notes.title: Build 10614707: Time Limit Feature Update
notes.notes:
[b]Please update to Build 10614707 as soon as possible![/b]

This build has the Time Limit Feature update.

[u]How the Time Limit feature works works:[/u]
To enable the feature, on the Start Panel, click on the time limit checkbox (under where it says "Time Limit:") so the box is check marked.  Then, in the time limit input field, type in the number of minutes you want to play the game (ten minutes minimum).  Then, click on the Start Game button to start playing.

The game time remaining will count down to zero.  At that point, whoever has the higher score is declared the winner.  If the scores are tied, the game will be declared a draw.

NOTE: There is an inactivity timer built in which will pause the game after thirty seconds while a timed game is playing.  This is to discourage players from just playing a few rounds until they are ahead and then just waiting for the time to run out.

I encourage you all to please let me know what you think about the new feature after you've tried it.  Thank you.

Jack Eisenfeld
Developer of WAR Card Game_uvr
P.S.: I'm sorry about the duplicate messages.  I had a problem while posting this update that caused me to have to type two messages.  This is the message you should take note of.  Ignore the previous one.

notes.title: Build 10614707: Time Limit Feature Update
notes.notes:
[b]Please update to Build 10614707 as soon as possible![/b]

The time limit feature was added in this update.

[u]How to use the time limit feature:[/u]
To enable the time limit feature, on the Start Panel, click the checkbox under where it says "Time Limit" so that the box is check marked.  Then, in the time limit input field, type in the number of minutes you want to play the game (10 minutes minimum) and press Enter.   Then click the Start Game button to begin playing.  

The game time remaining will count down to zero.  At that time, whoever is leading (has the higher score) will be declared the winner.  If the scores are tied, the game will be declared a draw.

NOTE: There is an inactivity timer built-in that's set for 30 seconds.  This is to discourage players from just playing a few rounds until they are leading then wait until the time runs out.

notes.title: Requesting Player Feedback!
notes.notes:
I'm working on a Time Limit feature for WAR Card Game_uvr before I work on the Achievements.  I'm trying to shorten the game to a more reasonable length since it usually goes on for an hour or so or longer until the cards finally play out and there's a winner.  It would work in the following way: 
 
The player would enable the feature by clicking a checkbox (on the Start Panel) which would enable an input field (also on the Start Panel) into which the player would type a number of minutes (currently ten minutes minimum) then start the game.  The game clock would count down the game time remaining until the time limit is reached at which time whichever player is leading would be declared the winner.  If there is a tie, the game is declared a draw.
 
I would like player's and potential player's feedback on what they think should be the minimum time limit as well as how they think I should handle potential stalling on the part of the player.  The player could easily win just by playing a few rounds until he or she is ahead and then just wait for the rest of the ten minutes to pass and win.

I would also like feedback on what kind of reward(s) you think players should get for playing the game without the time limit and winning.  I believe they should get some sort of longevity achievement award.
What do you think?  Please enter the discussion here or email me at wardevjack@gmail.com.  I would greatly appreciate it.  Thank you.

notes.title: Update Build 10483924 is now live! (Please read this announcement!)
notes.notes:
The following changes were implemented in this update:

-a yellow outline was added to the cursor (mouse pointer) so it could be seen more easily
-the Game Panel was made to stay in place when you click either the Deal Cards or Compare Cards buttons so you don't have to right click every time to bring the Game Panel back up

NOTE: The Game Panel does disappear when a WAR occurs or the game is paused (in order to make way for whichever banner is being displayed).  When a WAR occurs, you will have to right click to bring back the Game Panel but the Game Panel will come back automatically when the game is resumed after being paused.

notes.title: Coming Soon: Achievements
notes.notes:
I am working on adding achievements to the game.  The achievements will unlock after you win a certain number of manual games (games played manually rather than using auto-play).  The following set of achievements are being implemented:

Card Warrior Level 1 - Card Page			        1 win
Card Warrior Level 2 - Card Squire			        5 wins
Card Warrior Level 3 - Card Knight (or Knightess)	10 wins
Card Warrior Level 4 - Card Lord (or Lady)		25 wins
Card Warrior Level 5 - Card Baron (or Baroness)	50 wins
Card Warrior Level 6 - Card King (or Queen)		Highest wins above 50

For the Card King (or Queen) achievement, the player who has the highest number of wins above 50 will be given this achievement so there will be only one player who gets this achievement.  I intend to set up a leaderboard to show the players who have over 50 wins and whoever is ranked number one will receive the Card King (or Queen) achievement.  Hopefully, you (the players) will encourage me to continue my efforts to implement these features.  Thank you.
